result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on an integral of the form $\int f(s+z)e^{2\pi i z z}\,dz\int_0^\infty e^{-2yz-\alpha y/2\pi i+y^2/4\pi i}\dots dy$, deriving a differential equation for it, solving by power series with recursions for the coefficients $a_n$, $a_n^m$ and $c_n^m$, plus side work on $\int x^{1/3}(1-x)^{2/3}dx$ and a hypergeometric-type equation.
result.transcription:
$\frac{1}{\pi i}\int f(s+z)\,e^{2\pi i z z}\,\partial z\int_0^\infty e^{-2yz-\frac{\alpha y}{2\pi i}+\frac{y^2}{4\pi i}}(\alpha+y)^{s}\,\partial y$
$=\frac{1}{\pi i}\int f(s+z)$ [?]
$\frac{\partial\omega}{\partial z}\int 4\pi i z-2(y+\alpha)+2\alpha$
$\frac{\partial\omega}{\partial z}=(4\pi i z+2\alpha)f(s)-2f(s+1)$
$\int d\left(e^{2\pi i zz-2yz-\frac{\alpha y}{2\pi i}+\frac{y^2}{4\pi i}}(\alpha+y)^{s+1}\right)=\left(-2z-\frac{2\alpha}{2\pi i}\right)f(s+1)+\frac{1}{2\pi i}f(s+2)+(s+1)f(s)$
$-2z-\frac{\alpha}{2\pi i}+\frac{y}{2\pi i}$
$\frac{1}{2\pi i}f(s+2)=\frac{4\pi i z+2\alpha}{4\pi i}f(s+1)-\frac{1}{4\pi i}\frac{\partial f(s+1)}{\partial z}$
$=-\left(z+\frac{\alpha}{2\pi i}\right)f(s+1)-\frac{1}{4\pi i}\frac{\partial f(s+1)}{\partial z}+(s+1)f(s)$
$-\frac{1}{4\pi i}\frac{\partial f(s+1)}{\partial z}=\frac{1}{8\pi i}\frac{\partial^2\omega}{\partial z^2}-\frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial(z+\frac{\alpha}{2\pi i})\omega}{\partial z}$
$=\frac{1}{8\pi i}\frac{\partial^2\omega}{\partial z^2}-2\pi i\left(z+\frac{\alpha}{2\pi i}\right)^2\omega-\frac12\omega+(s+1)\omega$
$=\frac{1}{8\pi i}\frac{\partial^2\omega}{\partial z^2}-\omega(2\pi i zz+2z\alpha)=-e^{2\pi i zz}$
$s=\frac{\alpha^2}{2\pi i}-\frac12$
$(\alpha)^{\frac{\alpha^2}{2\pi i}+\frac12}$
$\omega=\sum a_n z^n$
$\frac{1}{8\pi i}\sum a_n n(n-1)z^{n-2}-2\pi i\sum a_n z^{n+2}-2\alpha\sum a_n z^{n+1}$
$a_n=-\frac{\alpha}{\pi i}a_{n+1}+\frac{a_{n+4}(n+4)(n+3)}{16(\pi i)^2}$
$a_{n+1}=\frac{a_{n+4}(n+4)(n+3)}{16\alpha\pi i}$
$a_{-n+1}=a_{-n+4}\frac{(-n+4)(-n+3)}{16\alpha\pi i}$
$a_{-3n-4}=a_{-3n-1}\frac{-3n-1(3n-2)}{16\alpha\pi i}$
$a_{3n-4}=a_{3n-1}\frac{3n-1\,3n-2}{2^3\alpha\pi i}$
$3^{n+1}\frac{(16\alpha\pi i)^{n+1}\,n+1!}{3n+3!}a_{-3n-4}=a_{-3n-1}\frac{n!(16\alpha\pi i)^n3^n}{3n!}$
$z^{-3n-1}\frac{3n!}{n!(16\alpha\pi i)^n3^n}$
$\int x^{\frac13}(1-x)^{\frac23}\partial x$
$(1-x)^{-\frac43}x^{-\frac23}$
$(1-x)\frac{\partial^2y}{\partial\log x^2}+7x\frac{\partial y}{\partial\log x}-(4+12x)y=\frac{1}{1-x}$
$a_n^0=\frac{3n-2\;3n-1}{16\pi i}a_{n-1}^0$
$a_n^0=\frac{3n!}{(16\pi i)^n\,n!\,3^n}$
$a_n^1=-\frac{3n-3!\;3n-1}{(16\pi i)^{n-2}3^{n-1}\,n-1!\,5\cdot16}$
$a_n^m=a_{n-1}^{m-1}\pi i\,c_n^m$
$c_n^m+1-\frac{(3n-2-4m)(3n-1-4m)}{16\pi i}c_{n-1}^m\frac{a_{n-2}^{m-1}}{a_{n-1}^{m-1}}$
$c_n^1=P\,3n-1=-\frac{3n-1}{5\cdot16}$
$a_n^1-\frac{(3n-5)(3n-6)}{16\pi i}a_{n-1}^1=-\pi i\frac{3n-3!}{(16\pi i)^{n-1}3^{n-1}(n-1)!}$
$16c_n^1-\frac{3n-6}{3n-4}c_{n-1}^1\,16=-1$
$P\,16(3n-1)-(3n-6)c=-1$
$P=-\frac{1}{5\cdot16}$
$a_0^0=1$, $a_1^0=\frac{1}{8\pi i}$, $a_2^0=\frac{5}{32(\pi i)^2}$, $a_2^1=-\frac18$
$\sum a_n^m(-3n-1+2m)(-3n-2+4m)z^{-3n-4+2m}\alpha^{-n}/16\pi i$
$a_n^m+\pi i\,a_{n-1}^{m-1}-\frac{(3n-2+4m)(3n-1-4m)}{16\pi i}a_{n-1}^m=0$
$c_n^0=\frac{3n!}{(16\pi i)^n3^n n!}$
$-\frac{5}{32}+\frac{3\cdot4}{16\cdot8}$

methods.what: Second-order ODE satisfied by the integral
methods.quote: $=\frac{1}{8\pi i}\frac{\partial^2\omega}{\partial z^2}-\omega(2\pi i zz+2z\alpha)=-e^{2\pi i zz}$
